notes.title: HotFix 1
notes.content: Fixed a spawn error where players would spawn into a wall upon playing the main game

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
-Fixed a few sections that would cause you to be stuck in an infinite load screen loop.

****There is a bug that has been reported in regards to level 0 where small sections of the level may not load. This is being looked into and a fix will be out asap.* Should you have trouble with this and have a save file from a previous playthrough, you can go to the hub (there is a doorway at the beginning of level 0, where all the levels will be unlocked for the time being.

notes.title: HotFix#1
notes.content: Fixed a bug causing the generator in the parking garage to tell players to look for a battery instead of gas

notes.title: Major Update
notes.content:
This update is the biggest one yet! I have added a hub level for you to choose which level you would like to play in the main multiplayer mode! Be warned though, they aren't unlocked from the start!

Theres been animation adjustments, Ai adjustments, numerous bug fixes, and even a little bit more to do in each level!

The dungeon crawler mode has recieved level modifications for more streamlined play and along with bug fixes in that mode as well!

notes.title: Bug patch/ enemy correction
notes.content:
-Fixed an error where partygoers spawned in level 3 instead of the correct enemy
-Fixed a bug preventing respawning in Level fun
-Fixed a bug preventing sanity to work around most enemies

notes.title: Ai updates and discord link fix
notes.content: Fixed the discord link and redid most of the ai for balancing.

notes.title: Steam name interface
notes.content: Fixed a bug where the game wouldnt get player name from steam at startup causing players issues connecting to online sessions.

notes.title: Movement patch
notes.content:
-Further fixed a bug regarding movement in multiplayer.
-Made items delete correctly once picked up to prevent item duping.

notes.title: UI patch
notes.content: Fixed a bug where if characters were to die and their pause menu or inventory screen was up, they wouldnt be able to close it upon respawning.

notes.title: Regular update
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where level 1 couldnt be completed.
Fixed some ai issues
Fixed a bug where level 3 youd fall through the map.
